Evaluate scATAC-seq Differential Accessibility (DA) Fidelity (Sub-category V-B)

Source: R/05_metrics_de_signal.R
evaluate_atac_da_fidelity.Rd

Evaluates the preservation of Differentially Accessible Regions (DARs) between reference and simulated scATAC-seq datasets using biological replicate pseudobulks and edgeR-QLF (Squair et al., Nature Communications 2021; Teo et al., Nature Communications 2024 / Libra) across standard benchmarking metrics (Duo et al., Genome Biology 2024 / Simpipe).

Usage

evaluate_atac_da_fidelity(
  ref_data,
  sim_data,
  ref_celltypes,
  sim_celltypes,
  batch_ref = NULL,
  batch_sim = NULL,
  binarize = TRUE,
  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
  logfc_cutoff = 0,
  min_cells = 3,
  min_reps = 2
)

Arguments

ref_data

Reference scATAC-seq count matrix (peaks x cells).

sim_data

Simulated scATAC-seq count matrix (peaks x cells).

ref_celltypes

Factor or character vector of reference cell types.

sim_celltypes

Factor or character vector of simulated cell types.

batch_ref

Factor or character vector of biological replicate / batch labels for reference cells.

batch_sim

Factor or character vector of biological replicate / batch labels for simulated cells.

binarize

Logical. If TRUE (default for scATAC-seq), binarizes single-cell counts prior to pseudobulk aggregation.

fdr_cutoff

Adjusted p-value significance threshold (default 0.05).

logfc_cutoff

Absolute log2 fold-change cutoff (default 0).

min_cells

Minimum number of cells per cell type (default 3).

min_reps

Minimum number of replicates per group (default 2).

Value

A list containing:

da_summary_table

Tidy summary data.frame with 6 scATAC-seq DA metrics: da_score, pval_dist_score, true_proportion, accuracy, precision, recall, f1_score, and auc

pairwise_results

Detailed contrast-level data.frame with per-contrast metrics and confusion matrix counts

pseudobulks_ref

List of reference pseudobulk matrices per cell type

pseudobulks_sim

List of simulated pseudobulk matrices per cell type

da_results_ref

List of edgeR-QLF DA results for reference

da_results_sim

List of edgeR-QLF DA results for simulation

Details

Category V is divided into two distinct sub-categories:

  • Sub-category V-A (scRNA-seq Differential Expression): Computes 8 metrics: de_score, pval_dist_score, true_proportion, accuracy, precision, recall, f1_score, and auc.

  • Sub-category V-B (scATAC-seq Differential Accessibility): Computes 8 metrics: da_score, pval_dist_score, true_proportion, accuracy, precision, recall, f1_score, and auc.

If batch_ref or batch_sim is NULL, the analysis is gracefully skipped, adhering to the strict rule that single-cell ATAC-seq biological signal evaluation requires genuine biological replicates to prevent pseudoreplication bias.

Examples

data(example_scatac, package = "scSimEval")
rep_id <- factor(rep(c("Rep1", "Rep2"), length.out = ncol(example_scatac$ref)))
res <- evaluate_atac_da_fidelity(
  ref_data = example_scatac$ref,
  sim_data = example_scatac$sim,
  ref_celltypes = example_scatac$cell_types,
  sim_celltypes = example_scatac$cell_types,
  batch_ref = rep_id,
  batch_sim = rep_id
)
#> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes
#> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes
res$da_summary_table
#>                             SubCategory          Metric      Value
#> 1 scATAC-seq Differential Accessibility pval_dist_score 0.85633794

#> 3 scATAC-seq Differential Accessibility       precision 0.50000000

#> 5 scATAC-seq Differential Accessibility        f1_score 0.15384615
#> 6 scATAC-seq Differential Accessibility             auc 0.83673469
#>                                                         Direction
#> 1    Higher is better (1.0 = uniform null p-values, no inflation)
#> 2             Higher is better (1.0 = perfect DAR classification)
#> 3                 Higher is better (1.0 = zero false discoveries)
#> 4                 Higher is better (1.0 = 100% true DAR recovery)
#> 5 Higher is better (1.0 = harmonic balance of precision & recall)
#> 6         Higher is better (1.0 = perfect ranking discrimination)
#>                                                      Framework
#> 1 Libra Pseudobulk edgeR-QLF (Squair 2021; Teo 2024; Duo 2024)
#> 2 Libra Pseudobulk edgeR-QLF (Squair 2021; Teo 2024; Duo 2024)
